title: Prepare for Microsoft Certification Exam AI-103: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure
description:
Join us for a live session featuring Lead Technical Trainer, Georgia Kalyva, as she walks through what to expect from the AI‑103: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure exam. Georgia will highlight the exam’s focus areas, the skills being assessed, and the practical tips that can help you prepare effectively and confidently. This 60‑minute session is designed to give you clear guidance you can use as you work toward this certification.
